purpose: Read-only metadata snapshot for cross-computer research and chat handoff.
notes: Only this inventory is intended for Git submission; listed source and run members remain local and untracked.
Hashes record observed local bytes without changing experiment identities, accepting responses, or sealing a new experiment.
Credential locations, caches and locks are excluded from file hashing. Lock presence is state only; contents were not read.
The long-cohort preparation has no formal target calls or human approvals; CLI-v3 records an explicit user pause.
No files were executed, no model was called, and no existing artifact was changed by inventory creation.
Git ignored files are not enumerated as material members. Known lock files are separately listed as presence state.
